future_execution.new_builds: Only if required after source changes; serial one explicit target --parallel 1. Never bypass Cortex.

laboratory_gate.zero_state_equality: exact full14 equality at every point
laboratory_gate.domain_check: Independent Cartesian coupled_rates with zero de at every successful point; strict source/model domain, no clamp or widened shell.
laboratory_gate.scales: sigma6=p_scale,e=1,h6=R,Omega=1; compare initial and returned state at every matching point
laboratory_gate.controller_checks: p0 lateral strains zero; p1 radial effective stress difference from initial <= max(1,abs(initial radial))*1e-8 plus 2e-8 Pa rounding allowance; p2/p3 trace(strain) <= 1e-14; p3 per-increment signed q change minus prescribed control change under same stress budget; p4 all normal strains equal within 1e-14; zero shears within 1e-14 for these axisymmetric cases.
laboratory_gate.exact_loading: use existing createLoading and exact bit echo; never compare legacy cyclic values as identical to versioned waveform
laboratory_gate.legacy_loading: existing backend historical waveform; shape, own-state, controller/domain/volume/parity gates apply; no new equivalence claim
laboratory_gate.import_export: matching catalogue hash, all14 finite initial/point state, parameters, exact loading bits and settings preserved; saved result checked; fresh replay, never resume hidden state
laboratory_gate.failure: No negative case commits an initial point; valid zero recovery equals clean control exactly. Separate forced-update failure retains complete last committed prefix and recovers; do not confuse failed prefix with full success.

origin_rate_gate.directions: six positive Mandel basis increments scaled 1e-6, their negatives, and zero:26 cases
origin_rate_gate.oracle: tools/reference_gis2024_coupled.py, independent Cartesian supplied-host algebra; freeze literal expected14 rates and parameter/input/source hashes before compiled observations
origin_rate_gate.limitation: Origin rate agreement does not qualify derivatives, saturation-boundary integration or complete-update tangents.

browser_gate: Actual project-prefix packaged browser, not Node alone; see numbered acceptance ledger in INTEGRATION_PLAN.md.
